mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in INDPRO and RSAFS for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production and retail sales, reflecting deteriorating economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in HOUST below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction and related spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of HOUST below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and UNRATE above 3.5% in the same month signals strong labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 3.5% AND UNRATE > 3.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS growth and UNRATE exceed 3.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent FEDFUNDS rate below 1% for more than six months signals an extended period of monetary accommodation, which supports risk asset valuations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS < 1% for more than six months.

mechanism_narrative: A YoY increase in GDPC1 above 3% combined with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 2% signals both strong demand and inflationary pressure, which raises concerns about future rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY > 3% AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 YoY > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% in the same month.
